<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Final article abstract and journal pages 8071-8074; Final article Tables 1-3; Final article equation-of-state fit paragraph and Figure 4.
- **Equation:** The final 298 K isotherms use a Birch equation with K0'=4 fixed; Peritheos stores the algebraically identical BM3 special case.
- **Parameters:** Final-publication Table 1 gives V0=163.53(10) A3 for Fe20; the room-temperature fit paragraph gives K0=261(4) GPa with K0'=4.
- **Fit scope:** The shared elastic coefficient was fitted only to the nine 300 K Fe10 rows in Table 2. The MgSiO3 and Fe20 rows demonstrate indistinguishable compression, while their Table 1 V0 values remain composition specific.

</details>
